corrections.caveats: The cjson-vs-nlohmann numbers cross parser categories: cjson's index/tape parse vs nlohmann's full owning-tree parse. Plain cjson parse is much slower, e.g. 0.74 GB/s on 1MB, tied with yyjson. cjson-reuse trails simdjson-dom(warm) on 12 of 18 documents, and cjson-ondemand trails simdjson-ondemand on every document. For serialize, the GB/s ratios disagree with the cyc/op ratios (1MB: 3.16x GB/s but 0.94x cyc/op), so treat the serialize GB/s wins with caution. The repo is ~7 weeks old, has 2 stars and one author, and no third party has reproduced it.
